optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: epoch cosine20; same scratch source path;explicitCFO identity slot zero

multilevel.sampling: independent A/B, each same-day 6TX x 5RX x2 L, cross-batch overlap allowed
multilevel.style_scope: 4 legal sameTX/day crossRX distinctPID L style candidates; eval batch-mean CE chooses hard; random control has identical search cost; selected train forward shares clean dropout RNG

rx_action.L_fit: other five TX AND other two days
rx_action.U_fit: all six L TX, other two days; U TX never read
rx_action.critic_fit: actual deterministic CE increment on up to32L, identity detached; smoothL1; zero-action anchored
rx_action.action_selection: eight candidates: four other sourceRX times two fixed scales; no identity class prediction in bank lookup

source_loader_config.sampling: same seed-private RX/day-balanced full permutation for L and independently U; no TX grouping/hidden U labels
source_loader_config.feature_target: main identity margin sensitivities and supervised style at time_down/t2.pool

engineering.mix_layer_policy: alternate from active step445; exactly one layer per update
engineering.mix_source: L_s only; different TX donors; repeated donors allowed
engineering.labels_smoothing_scope: L identity CE only; fixed peer U targets unchanged

title: 十三种网络纯CE E200追加四种子：CVS为残差融合版本

name: 固定三成员概率集成：整源RX留出30轮方差检验
description: 完整native身份网络的固定等权概率集成，区分初始化/训练方差收益；不是新增物理不变性，成本为单成员3倍。

data.representation: raw received residual/post_sync/noeq IQ; fixed common temporal linear projection

roles.U_s: 56700 hidden and unopened

rows.seed_notes: primaryensembleseed2701;actualmemberinitializer=2026102701 and dropoutstream sameactualseed;allmembers samplerprimary+101;physical split unchanged;no augmentation/support/evalrandomness

risk_recipe.auxiliary_batch_scope: at most32 fresh source-L packets; R may separately re-encode at most32 cached audit IQ packets; count both
risk_recipe.source_selection: fixed final epoch; all three rows tested
risk_recipe.reference: periodically frozen own student; no EMA teacher
risk_recipe.action_scope: bounded post-receive linear/phase increments; no satellite simulator in training
risk_recipe.source_u_scope: No U access in any arm

source_stress.ranking: clean feasibility then stress mean+worst RX risk; descriptive source-only ranking across three seeds; within .2pp prefer fewer auxiliary parameters
source_stress.selection: three-seed source V only; clean feasibility .5pp then mean+worstRX performance; exact ties lower ratio

feature_recipe.calibration_scope: mature source-L relation buckets; fixed once, no later weight adaptation
feature_recipe.style_scope: native labeled clean CE only; no extra CE or KL
feature_recipe.statistical_ema: gradient statistics only, not an EMA teacher

reference_E200.role: comparison only; never loaded for initialization

optimizer.name: AdamW

receiver_risk.weight_update: logq += .01 * detached current within-RX mean CE; softmax after update

receiver_risk.absent_RX: zero risk and no logq increment; renormalize applied q over present RX
receiver_risk.balanced_control: equal mean over present RX; no adversarial weight update
receiver_risk.ERM_control: original scalar CE returned unchanged, same group calculations for observation
receiver_risk.enable: all11100 native L steps from epoch1; no extra warmup, reset or clipping
receiver_risk.original_U: same old batch_neighbor/ownEMA/.16UCE/.01entropy; no reweighting or label access
receiver_risk.optimizer: original AdamW lr.0002 WD.0001 cosine; no new optimizer/head/forward
receiver_risk.scope: GroupDRO-style receiver grouping adaptation; not a reproduction of original datasets or regularization study

config.cohort_definition: First five existing deterministic L180 cohorts;2 per TX/RX/day
config.parent_rule: Predefined first nominal seed SIG_TIME control, never target-best parent
config.gradient: Gradient of sum true-class default-head logits with respect to actual t2 output; signed, mean over96 channels
config.spatial_rule: Keep signed gradient mean strictly below linear two-thirds quantile per packet
config.packet_rule: Apply spatial mask only to probability-drop values at or above linear two-thirds batch quantile
config.random_control: Same selected physical packets and exact per-packet zero count; independently shuffle spatial mask per packet
config.classifier: Unchanged existing default ResidualPhysicalHead cosine6x160 scale30; never fitted
config.model_mode: eval; diagnostic derivatives only; no training/update; masks removed after each row
config.V_builder: Reuse existing VALIDATED_ONCE loader; V returned and discarded without forward

qualification.on_pass: Only a separately registered unchanged02/03 source diagnostic may follow
qualification.on_fail: Stop this fixed source self-challenge route; no mask-rate or layer scan

config.limitation: Source compatibility of temporal RSC, not a PACS reproduction or proof of new evidence, DG, SSL or84

last_event.note: Source900/3600forward/20layers60vectors completeindependentrecount;PASS confirms targetedchallenge only. Actualt1/t2 gradientcos negative,0updates/headfit/query. Onlyunchanged02/03 sourceprobe mayfollow once predefinedparents final50complete.
